but statistics show that being struck by lightning is far more common than purchasing this gun

a classic hard to surpass

SIG Sauer's new assault rifle 
featuring two charging handles and many holes

Current PLA assault rifle

The latest generation sniper rifle produced by Gepard, light and compact

Short assault rifle introduced to the Soviet army in 1979

A 12.7mm automatic rifle developed by KBP Design Bureau

A high-end civilian competition handgun custom-made by Taran Tactical

An anti-material sniper rifle produced by Accuracy International 
looks like a larger AWM?

Standard bearer of the Soviet Union 
though it seems to have killed more of its own than enemies
suffuse.gun.trapper50cal.desc: Hold on, let me load a round first...

Talking tree? One round! 
Fortified MG nest? One round! 
Liquid metal T1000 robot...? One round!
suffuse.gun.ks23m.desc:
An oversized rifled shotgun. 
Also a new career path for decommissioned aircannon barrels.
suffuse.gun.dvl10.desc:
A compact silent sniper rifle from the Russian Federation. 
A silent blade made of carbon fiber and titanium alloy.
suffuse.gun.aiyasinrpg.desc:
Soviet RPG-7 Rocket Launcher 
but with a Al-Yassin 105mm rocket manufactured by Hamas
suffuse.gun.gepardpdw.desc:
A juvenile 74u. 
Honestly, I don't know how to describe this either~
suffuse.gun.kapcdw.desc:
Compact and lightweight. 
The dual gas chamber design greatly reduces recoil.
suffuse.gun.mpdr.desc:
Its futuristic design inspired many sci-fi individual weapons. 
Unfortunately, the original gun never made it past prototyping.
suffuse.gun.pf98a.desc:
Infantry anti-tank weapon designed and manufactured in China 
used to destroy tanks and other armored vehicles
suffuse.gun.qlu11.desc:
Your accuracy is a bit loose. 
But your blast radius compensates for that.
suffuse.gun.svd.desc:
A sniper rifle named after its desinger 
the world`s first rifle specifically made for snipers
suffuse.gun.np762.desc:
A Chinese P226.

Goes well with Dragon Breath shells
But beware of Raptors` ambush

Early exploration of British self-loading pistols
Bulk but reliable mechanism can bear through muddy trenchs
§dCommissioned by Swamp_Derrick

Germen craftswork combined with .45 caliber

suffuse.gun.qbz191.desc:
Next-gen standard issue weapon for the Peaple`s Liberation Army
Ditched the bullpup configuration of the previous design
suffuse.gun.ags30.desc:
Russian automatic grenade launcher currently in production
and in service with the Russian armed forces.
suffuse.gun.rpd.desc: what will happen when you make an ak bigger?
suffuse.gun.saddam_golden_ak.desc:
One of the golden collections in Saddam`s Palace
Taken by US Army during Iraq War
suffuse.gun.ar57.desc: Draw a doge face on your opponent`s body armor
suffuse.gun.fm9.desc:
Prototype compact submachinegun chambered in 9mm
Produced by Magpul only as a proof of concept.
suffuse.gun.m203.desc: Say hello to my little friend
suffuse.gun.rm277.desc:
A bullpup-configured rifle developed by General Dynamics for its bid in the NGSW program
featuring innovative polymer-cased ammunition,
though ultimately losing out to SIG Sauer's submission with many holes.
suffuse.gun.lifecard.desc:
Life`s final insurance 
though you may only get the chance for once
suffuse.gun.qjb_201.desc: The new firepower provider for the infantry squad.
suffuse.gun.gen12.desc: Fancy weapon, probably wont make you as deadly as John Wick
suffuse.gun.qba221.desc:
Its first users were naval escort forces, who saw the potential of an automatic shotgun in VBSS close-quarters brawls.
After all, as the saying goes: you can't sweep the world if you can't even handle one room.
suffuse.gun.cslr4.desc: High Precision rifle manufactured domesticly, costs nearly 10 bucks for one shot
suffuse.gun.desert.desc: Movie stars or game protagonists, everone loves it
suffuse.gun.famas.desc: The French made it to hold 25 round capacity but also went with a 3-round burst design, maybe thats how mathematics works
suffuse.gun.qjz171.desc:
The SAW`s got the best firepower for a single soldier, right? 
Okay, a GPMG is kinda heavy… but you could still go Rambo with it, right? 
Wait — what do you mean you’re lugging a .50 cal and running?
suffuse.gun.qcq171.desc:
Next gen SMG made in China,
probably more needed by special forces and air crew members than by regular infantry
suffuse.gun.mg338.desc: General purpose machinegun manufactured by SIG SAUER, tell it apart from FN EVOLYS and M250 can be quite a challenge
suffuse.gun.qlz87.desc:
A grenade machine gun is scary.
One that moves as nimbly as an infantryman? Even scarier.
But one that’s nimble and doesn’t lob grenades like a tennis ball? Hell out of nightmares.
suffuse.gun.ptrd41.desc:
Soviet anti tank rifle that played an important role in the Great Patriotic War, 
Face the fear, pull the trigger. 
Глаза боятся, а руки делают。
suffuse.gun.l115a3.desc:
Teammates all wiped out?
Save it for next round
suffuse.gun.qbu88.desc:
Some people tried shove its bipod in the ground like they do for LMGs, and it snapped.
but it doesn`t matter, putting a backpack under it makes it more accurate than using the bipod
suffuse.gun.l119a2.desc:
British special forces never seem to fancy their own homemade guns.
Instead, they've fallen hard for this maple-scented rifle.
Making friends pays off — who knows?
One phone call later, your knight in shining armor might just show up with an L119A2, ready to snatch you from the clutches of those pesky terrorists.
suffuse.gun.type81_lmg.desc: Type 56 Semi for the singles. Type 56 Assault for the crowds. The Type 81 squad auto pats its 75-round drum: 'Guess I'll be taking care of the whole family.'
suffuse.gun.m32a1.desc: Rounds like this that can blow you all over the place, i have six of `em.
suffuse.gun.mk47.desc: A new alternative for AR users manufactured by CMMG.
suffuse.gun.qsz92g.desc: Shoved away most of the issues of the original Type 92, this new model uplifts overall performance far beyond. Despite not needed for most of the time, the People`s Police always deserves a better weapon.
suffuse.gun.mk3.desc:
An upgraded model of the FN MinimiFN
Enhanced usability and extensibility
suffuse.gun.qbz951b.desc: Short Barrel version of the Type 95 Family, extremely compact but able to deliver immense firepower
suffuse.gun.qjb951.desc: LMG Version of the Type 95 Family, can be modified as a sniper for competition
suffuse.block.workbench.desc:
Modular workstation for fabricating weapons
from pistols to heavy ordnances.
what could possibly mean for the strange blueprint and
the mysterious cylinder?
